mentions.name: RSS reader / dashboard
mentions.description: This app is an RSS reader and dashboard featuring AI summarize buttons powered by gemini-flash-lite, plus other features the author wanted. A "war mode" (dark mode only) displays a specified list of OSINT-style X users sequentially in a grid, along with a bottom ticker of selected Polymarket markets.
mentions.audience: The comment states the user is the author himself ("The user (me!)").
mentions.source_excerpt:
An RSS reader / dashboard.

It has AI summarize buttons (gemini-flash-lite is so fast!) along with other features I wanted. I'm almost done adding a "war mode". The user (me!) specifies a list of OSINT style x users which show up sequentially in a grid along with a ticker on the bottom of polymarket markets I've chosen.
